name: Research or publication input
about: Review a source, expert input, hypothesis, dataset or material critique
title: ""
---

## Original input and question

Exact public URL/version/date or authorized bounded summary. Do not paste private
correspondence without permission. What existing conclusion/question might change?

Clarify the intended question and material scope with the maintainer. Record
confirmed decisions and open questions; do not treat assumptions as agreed intent.

## Existing owners

Source/research IDs, relevant research/brief/manuscript/blueprint and issue links.
A candidate is not an accepted finding.

## Review plan

Search original input and existing source/research uses. Select the existing
repository flow. Produce an impact report for maintainer review before substantive
integration (methods, limitations, contradictions, affected claims/figures/protocols,
include/exclude/narrow/defer recommendation).

## Acceptance criteria

Assign stable IDs and observable pass conditions before implementation. Map each
criterion to deterministic tests/policy and keep required human decisions explicit.

### AC01

- [ ] Exact source/version and limitations inspected.
- Deterministic check / required external evidence:
### AC02

- [ ] Complete relevant existing uses and conflicting evidence assessed.
- Deterministic check / required external evidence:
### AC03

- [ ] Impact report and required maintainer decision recorded.
- Deterministic check / required external evidence:
### AC04

- [ ] Accepted changes independently reviewed and validated as required.
- Deterministic check / required external evidence:
### AC05

- [ ] Canonical records synchronized through their own procedures.
- Deterministic check / required external evidence:
### AC06

- [ ] PR and issue completion summaries include merged state and remaining work.
- Deterministic check / required external evidence:

## Linked work and decisions

Owning PRs, exact `Refs #N` commits, cross-repository dependencies and dated
scope/decision changes. Analysis/review uses a dated issue anchor, short synopsis
and exact linked PR-file section in `review/issue-N/YYYY-MM-DD-kind.md`.

## Completion evidence

Run the owning acceptance policy/checks and report AC → check → result → exact
source/run → remaining gate. Reconcile current criteria and live PR/commit links
before readiness; missing, skipped, failed or stale evidence keeps acceptance open.
See [.github/ACCEPTANCE.md](../ACCEPTANCE.md) and CONTRIBUTING.md.
